description: Dinamik Çoklu Senaryo - k6 Yük Testi Dashboard (Pro)

targets.query:
from(bucket: "k6")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "vus")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["testName"] =~ /^${Senaryo:regex}$/)
  |> group()
  |> last()
  |> yield(name: "last")

from(bucket: "k6")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "http_reqs")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["testName"] =~ /^${Senaryo:regex}$/)
  |> group()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with success_count: if r["status"] == "200" and r["expected_response"] != "false" then float(v: r._value) else 0.0 }))
  |> reduce(fn: (r, accumulator) => ({ total: accumulator.total + float(v: r._value), successes: accumulator.successes + r.success_count }), identity: {total: 0.0, successes: 0.0})
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _value: if r.total > 0.0 then r.successes / r.total else 0.0 }))
  |> yield(name: "last")

from(bucket: "k6")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "http_reqs")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["testName"] =~ /^${Senaryo:regex}$/)
  |> group()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with error_count: if r["status"] != "200" or r["expected_response"] == "false" then float(v: r._value) else 0.0 }))
  |> reduce(fn: (r, accumulator) => ({ total: accumulator.total + float(v: r._value), errors: accumulator.errors + r.error_count }), identity: {total: 0.0, errors: 0.0})
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _value: if r.total > 0.0 then r.errors / r.total else 0.0 }))
  |> yield(name: "last")
